description:
Power Through Your Daily Ride
With 500W max power, enjoy responsive acceleration and reliable performance for everyday city commuting.

Go Further Between Charges
Travel up to 28 miles on a single charge, giving you more freedom for daily commutes, errands, and weekend rides.

More Speed, Less Time on the Road
Reach speeds of 28 MPH for a quicker, more exciting ride when conditions allow.

Smoother Rides Over Everyday Bumps
8.5-inch pneumatic tires help absorb road vibrations and improve comfort on paved streets and uneven surfaces.

Take on Hills with Confidence
With a rated 30° climbing capability, handle challenging inclines and hilly routes with greater confidence.
